context: Tests whether the agent correctly prepares a finished draft for publication: setting published to true, adding published_at for scheduled release, and documenting the correct git branch workflow. Graded by inspecting the article file and notes.md.

checklist.name: Published set to true
checklist.description: articles/typescript-generics-guide.md has published: true in its front matter

checklist.name: Published_at set correctly
checklist.description: Front matter includes published_at: "2026-06-01 09:00" (or equivalent JST datetime for June 1 2026 9 AM)

checklist.name: Content preserved
checklist.description: The rest of the front matter fields (title, emoji, type, topics) and body content are unchanged

checklist.name: Branch workflow documented
checklist.description: notes.md includes a git checkout -b (or git switch -c) command with the article/<slug> branch naming convention

checklist.name: Commit documented
checklist.description: notes.md includes a git commit command or step for the article file

checklist.name: Push documented
checklist.description: notes.md includes a git push command targeting the correct branch

checklist.name: PR step mentioned
checklist.description: notes.md mentions opening a pull request to merge the branch into main

checklist.name: notes.md created
checklist.description: A notes.md file exists at the root of the workspace
